/users/{userId}.description: Individual member profile containing identity, role, and preferences. Restricted so only the owner can read/update permitted fields.

/admins/{userId}.description: Protected administrative registry used by backend security rules for role checking.

/sellerApplications/{applicationId}.description: Seller applications. Users can create and read their own. Admin reviews and updates status.

/sellers/{sellerId}.description: Public store profiles for verified sellers. Verified merchants manage their own store information.

/products/{productId}.description: Marketplace products collection. Public can read published products. Verified sellers can manage their own products.

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Marketplace category registry. Publicly readable. Admin writeable.

/users/{userId}/cart/{itemId}.description: Authenticated user shopping cart subcollection. Strictly owner read/write.

/users/{userId}/wishlist/{productId}.description: Authenticated user saved products. Strictly owner read/write.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Customer orders. Customer can only access their own orders. Server-authoritative writes.

/orderItems/{orderItemId}.description: Order line items. Seller can only view their own items. Customer can view items for their order. Server-authoritative writes.

/payments/{paymentId}.description: Payment records. Payer can view their records. Server-authoritative writes.

/serviceCategories/{categoryId}.description: Tech and digital service categories. Publicly readable. Admin managed.

/experts/{expertId}.description: Ecosystem expert profiles. Public can view verified public profiles. Experts manage their own profile details. Admin controls verification.

/projectRequests/{requestId}.description: Customer service project requests. Strictly isolated between customer, assigned expert, and Nexovira management.

/projectRequests/{requestId}/updates/{up.description: Project communication subcollection. Accessible only to authorized project participants.

/expertApplications/{applicationId}.description: Applications to become an ecosystem expert. User can create and view own application. Admin reviews and approves.

/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Administrative audit trail. Strictly restricted to admin and management oversight.

/notificationEvents/{eventId}.description: Ecosystem notification logs. Accessible to authorized recipient and administrators.

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: Unified in-app notifications. Members can access their own notifications and mark them as read.

/userNotificationPreferences/{userId}.description: Member notification preferences across channels. Strictly owner read/write.

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Verified reviews and ratings. Public can read published reviews. Authenticated verified users can create and edit their reviews. Management can moderate.

/reviewReports/{reportId}.description: Review moderation flags and user reports. Authenticated users can submit reports. Management reviews and resolves.

/digitalProductCategories/{categoryId}.description: Categories for digital items and resources.

/digitalProducts/{productId}.description: Digital publications and media items. Public can view published items, creators manage their own, management moderates.

/digitalEntitlements/{entitlementId}.description: Digital ownership entitlements granting download access.

/digitalProductReports/{reportId}.description: Digital product moderation and content violation reports.

/wallets/{walletId}.description: User and platform financial wallets. Accessible to owner and authorized financial administrators.

/walletHolds/{holdId}.description: Administrative and risk holds placed on wallet funds.

/unifiedTransactions/{transactionId}.description: Unified financial transactions connecting orders, payments, refunds, commissions, and wallets.
